into a monsterous vermin...

Oh, wait, never mind.

Inner Essence doesn't work so well for this--does the Path suffer for the
same reasons?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <BAA3488B.D517%PD...@bigplanet.com>, Peter D Bakija

<PD...@bigplanet.com> writes:
>So anyways, if I have The Path of Metamorphosis in play, do I still have to
>pay the one blood to use Chiropterian Marrauder as an aggro hit? I know that
>Inner Essence doesn't work so well for this--does the Path suffer for the
>same reasons?

It's the difference between playing a card and activating an ability.

Chiropteran Marauder is played - costing no blood - and then the ability
it grants requires you to burn a blood. The latter ability is not the
playing of a card.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Peter D Bakija wrote:
> James Coupe wrote:
>
>
>>Chiropteran Marauder is played - costing no blood - and then the ability
>>it grants requires you to burn a blood. The latter ability is not the
>>playing of a card.
>
>
> That is what I figured, but the wording on Path is "vampires burn one less
> blood when playing cards...". It doesn't reference cost or paying. Just
> burning one less blood. As you have to burn one blood to use Chiropterian at
> superior, I figured it might work.

You burn 1 blood to get the benefit of aggravated damage as allowed by
the play of Chiropteran Maruader at superior. You burn no blood "when
playing" CM, so the Path won't reduce it.
